company.name: Airmada
company.shortDescription: Airmada is a building autonomous ground stations for drones.
company.description: Airmada builds automated ground stations for drones. These ground stations protect the drone, replace its batteries and launch missions. Airmada deploys ground stations at the clients' sites. Once deployed, the ground stations provide persistent drone coverage and availability. The automated ground stations allow operating missions without any human physical presence, thus reducing the price of drone enabled services dramatically.
